data.narrative:
AtmoCooling is a Seed-stage company in Climate & Energy founded by Paul Mahacek and Paul-Emmanuel Herve. The sector comprises a sparse peer universe of 8 private companies and 1 public comparator (Lnza). While broader Climate & Energy precedent exists—including peers like Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—a sufficiently dense same-stage peer set does not exist to support median-multiple triangulation.

The primary applicable method is stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised ($3.6M) as a proxy for post-money valuation, the analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier to reflect typical Seed-to-next-stage dilution patterns, yielding $9M post-money valuation. This methodology is grounded in observed progression rates across seed-to-Series A transitions in frontier technology.

The triangulation range is $8M (low) to $10M (high), with $9M as the median. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological leg; the primary constraint is insufficient peer density at matching stage and valuation tier to cross-validate via market comparables. Key uncertainties include the timing and terms of the next capital raise, burn rate trajectory, and realized progress on core technology milestones. Peer-set maturation or expansion toward Series A would support subsequent median-multiple validation.
